plan.disposition: Phase Matrix: Mini-Plan is FEATURE-only at small complexity; this run is intent=bug at small, so no plan artifact exists to review.

findings.finding: The guard is unconditionally true in production, so S9/S10 can now never emit a verdict. The only production caller is audit_phase_quality_on_stop.py -> pq.run_spec_checks('iterate', ...), whose run_id comes from pq.resolve_run_id. Nothing writes a top-level run_id into shipwright_run_config.json and no producer emits a run_started event, so the canonical iterate id never reaches S9/S10 and has_exact_iterate_entry is always False. Confirmed on disk: .shipwright/compliance/skill-compliance/iterate-unknown-unknown.json has run_id='unknown' with S9/S10 skipping on 'category=change' - an unrelated run's category, i.e. the bug being fixed. The verdicts lost are unsound ones, so this is an improvement, not a regression, but it must not be left implicit.
findings.suggestion: Land the guard; disclose the consequence in docs + docstring, pin it with a seam test, and file a follow-up card for the upstream run_id seam.

findings.finding: test_s9_s10_exact_entry_still_warns feeds run_id='real', a shape resolve_run_id cannot produce for the Stop audit. No test pins what run_id the production seam actually hands S9/S10, so the suite would stay green even if the guard fired on 100% of real invocations.
findings.suggestion: Add a test at the audit seam that calls pq.resolve_run_id and asserts against the resulting id.

findings.finding: Module docstring still read 'The S2/S3 run_id guard lives in _iterate_run_id.py' after S9/S10 were routed through the same helper, so the two files disagreed about the guard's fan-in.
The S9/S10 catalog rows list only category/UI-path/new-dir triggers and 'SKIPs otherwise'; they now also SKIP whenever the audited run_id has no exact iterate_history entry.
findings.suggestion: Append the run_id precondition to the S9/S10 rows.

findings.finding: check/check_id parametrize args carried no type annotations, and check_id was unused in two of the five parametrized tests.
findings.suggestion: Annotate as Callable[[Path, str], dict[str, Any]] and drop check_id where unread.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the seam test pins the production seam and will fail loudly if the seam is ever fixed — Production never passes the value the test passes. audit_phase_quality_on_stop.py coerces a blank SHIPWRIGHT_SESSION_ID to 'unknown' BEFORE calling resolve_run_id, so session_id='' is not a reachable input; the test asserted is_sentinel_run, a property of one branch only. Consequently the 'fails loudly when fixed' promise does not hold for the most likely fix, and if a session id ever reaches the hook the docs sentence 'the Stop audit supplies a sentinel' becomes false.
findings.suggestion: Parametrize over the two values the hook can actually emit, assert has_exact_iterate_entry is False as the carrying invariant, add SHIPWRIGHT_RUN_ID to delenv, and reword the docs row.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the recorded rationale identifies the case this guard protects — The docstring justified the non-sentinel half with 'a real run whose F5c entry is not written yet', which is unreachable through this seam. The only reachable non-sentinel is SHIPWRIGHT_LOOP_ID(+UNIT_ID) from campaign / autonomous-loop runs - and that is precisely the branch where the bogus verdict was ACTIONABLE, because non-sentinel snapshots survive load_actionable_findings. The fix is right; the reason on record was not, and would mis-scope the follow-up card.
findings.suggestion: Name the reachable trigger - loop-var run ids in campaign / autonomous-loop runs - in the module docstring.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the accepted trade is 'two checks go permanently inert' — In the sentinel branch both sides of the trade are invisible: sentinel-run findings were already excluded from all four rollup consumers, so the pre-fix bogus verdicts never reached the backlog, the SessionStart digest or the dashboard, and the post-fix SKIP removes nothing from them either. 'Permanently inert' overstates the loss.
findings.suggestion: State that in the sentinel branch the findings were already excluded from every rollup, confining the delta to the loop-id branch.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the SKIP evidence string is accurate for S9/S10 — unresolvable_run_id_skip hardcodes '(no exact iterate_history entry, no matching file)'; with candidates=[] the second clause is vacuous for S9/S10. Separately has_exact_iterate_entry swallows every exception, so an UNREADABLE iterate store yields the identical SKIP as a foreign audit context - pre-existing for S2/S3 but now extended to two more checks without note.
findings.suggestion: Emit the clause conditionally, or note the conflation next to the candidates=[] comments.

external_code.disposition: Phase Matrix: External LLM Review is 'skip' at small complexity (auto only at medium+). No risk flags fired to raise the floor. Internal cascade spec-reviewer/code-reviewer/doubt-reviewer all ran and are recorded completed.
